t: Bigg Boss 20: Salman Khan Slams Yung DSA, Scout OP For 'Bullying' Qazi Touqeer Over Spitting Row
d: Salman Khan called out housemates Yung DSA and Scout OP for ganging up on Qazi Touqeer after a week of clashes, even as Gauahar Khan later criticised Touqeer's own conduct in the dispute.
k: Bigg Boss 20 Qazi Touqeer Scout OP Yung DSA Salman Khan Gauahar Khan Mahhi Vij
x:
Singer Qazi Touqeer has become the centre of a week long dispute inside the  Bigg Boss 20  house, after a spitting incident during a debate task snowballed into accusations of bullying, a public rebuke from host Salman Khan, and a mixed reaction from former contestant Gauahar Khan.

   What Happened

The trouble began during a captaincy task debate on October 7, when Touqeer and Mahhi Vij argued against Uditi Singh and Arishfa Khan, according to  TimesBull  https://www.timesbull.com/bigg boss 20 qazi tauqeer vs scout op spitting controversy will bigg boss take action before weekend ka vaar/ . While speaking heatedly, spit from Touqeer reportedly landed on fellow contestant Scout OP, who accused him of doing it "on purpose." Touqeer said it was an accident and apologised, but Scout did not accept it, and the exchange escalated into a scuffle, the report said.

The friction did not end there. According to  Outlook India  https://www.outlookindia.com/art entertainment/television/salman khan calls out yung dsa scout op for bullying qazi touqeer on bigg boss 20 weekend ka vaar , Yung DSA and Scout OP kept clashing with and provoking Touqeer through the week, reportedly warning him they would "hurt him outside the house," and objected when he was given extra food — including eggs for protein — while recovering from a fever. Touqeer's team had earlier said on Instagram, per  Bollywood Shaadis  https://www.bollywoodshaadis.com/articles/bigg boss 20 qazi touqeer team shares health update 85337 , that he had been running a fever for days and was examined by the house doctor; some outlets reported he had dengue, but his team's statement did not confirm that diagnosis, so the exact illness remains unclear.

   Reaction

{{youtube:EftP LbL5W0}}

On the October  Weekend Ka Vaar  episode, Salman Khan addressed the house and told Yung DSA and Scout OP their conduct had crossed a line, per Outlook India's report: "You guys went after Qazi like bullies, then he retaliated, which was also wrong." He said there appeared to be "a bullying gang in the house," called Scout's gesture of serving Touqeer food "very uncouth... and heartless" given their poor equation, and questioned contestant Aamrapali's "double standards" after she had earlier called Touqeer a "moron" and a "pervert." Yung DSA and Scout OP apologised on the show, while Aamrapali defended her comments, Outlook India reported. Touqeer grew emotional, saying he had downplayed his pain to the house doctor so he could keep participating; Mahhi Vij also cried, saying the food served to the house had been poor.

The story took another turn on October 15, when Gauahar Khan — who had earlier publicly supported Touqeer, telling  Deccan Chronicle  https://www.deccanchronicle.com/entertainment/television/gauahar khan breaks down watching qazi touqeer cry on bigg boss 20 1994028  she cried watching him break down over a kind gesture from Arishfa Khan — reversed course on the spitting incident itself. She called Touqeer's actions "unacceptable and completely wrong" and said constant praise "had gone to his head," according to  Deccan Chronicle  https://www.deccanchronicle.com/entertainment/television/gauahar khan slams qazi touqeer over disgusting behaviour 1996046 .

{{youtube:LF1IOikKI M}}

   Background

Touqeer, a singer known from  Indian Idol , has been a recurring flashpoint this season — Salman Khan had separately pulled him up earlier for a remark directed at co contestant Kanika Mann. His clash with Scout OP and Yung DSA comes in the same stretch of the season that saw contestant Nakul Dhull permanently exit after a physical fight with wildcard Gullu  Kushal Tanwar .

   What's Next

With opinion on social media split between viewers defending Touqeer as a target of pile on and those siding with Scout OP and Gauahar Khan over the spitting incident, how the house treats Touqeer in the coming week — and whether producers take any formal action over the escalating threats — remains to be see

t: Anjali Arora's Kanpur Show Cut Short After Row Over 'Kacha Badam' Song, Organisers Threaten Legal Action
d: Influencer Anjali Arora reportedly left a Kanpur dandiya event after about 15 minutes when the DJ played her viral 'Kacha Badam' track, and the event's organiser has accused her of staging a publicity stunt and threatened legal action.
x:
Social media influencer Anjali Arora, who rose to fame through her viral dance video on the song "Kacha Badam," found herself at the centre of a new controversy after a guest appearance at a Nagada Night dandiya event in Kanpur turned tense. Videos from the event, held on Thursday, October 15, at Lajpat Bhawan in Motijheel according to one Hindi report, show Arora growing visibly upset on stage soon after she arrived.

   What happened

According to multiple reports, the trouble began when the DJ played "Kacha Badam" — the same song that made Arora a viral sensation years ago — as she stepped onto the stage. Clips circulating online show her stopping her performance, walking toward the DJ console, and speaking agitatedly with the DJ and her own team, some of whom also moved toward the console.

In one widely shared clip, Arora can be heard addressing the crowd, saying, according to a Hindi language report, that if people in Kanpur behaved this way, celebrities would stop coming to perform, since artists travel for such events because of the love audiences show them. She did not elaborate on camera, in the footage reviewed by outlets, on exactly what about the song or the moment upset her.

The event's organiser has alleged that Arora left the stage after roughly 15 minutes, even though, he claimed, the booking was for a 40 to 60 minute performance.

   The organiser's response

Speaking to reporters after the incident, the event organiser rejected Arora's reaction and called it a "publicity stunt," claiming the team had no idea the song would bother her and had played it precisely because it was the track that first brought her recognition. He said artists should understand that a stage carries its own dignity, and that any grievance ought to be raised with the management afterward rather than on stage.

The organiser also said the event had involved a significant investment, including lakhs of rupees paid to book Arora's appearance, and accused her of deliberately pushing videos of the incident to go viral on social media. He further alleged, without offering independent proof, that a similar episode had occurred during an earlier appearance by Arora in Kanpur, and claimed the controversy had damaged the city's reputation. He said he would pursue legal action against her over the disrupted event.

These claims come from the organiser alone, as reported by outlets including the Free Press Journal and StateMirror, and have not been independently verified. As of this report, Arora has not issued a public statement addressing the organiser's specific allegations, including the claim of a publicity stunt or the threat of legal action.

   Reactions and background

The irony of Arora appearing upset over the very song that made her a household name was not lost on social media users, several of whom mocked the moment online, according to StateMirror. The incident also follows recent scrutiny of Arora over her casting as Sita in a mythological stage production, "Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha," where some had questioned the choice given her viral dance videos; Arora had responded at the time that she felt no shame about her dancing and that it was simply a hobby.

{{youtube:teekNFzhGvQ}}

   What's next

Neither side has confirmed whether a formal police complaint or legal notice has actually been filed, despite the organiser's threat. Given that the available reporting leans heavily on the organiser's account and on video clips without full context of what was said at the DJ console, readers should treat the characterisation of Arora's conduct as allegation rather than established fact until she responds or further details emerge.

t: Bigg Boss 20: Nakul Dhull's Eviction Confirmed On Screen After Fight With Gullu
d: Bigg Boss has shown on air that wildcard contestant Nakul Dhull was evicted for his physical fight with Gullu, resolving days of rumour, though whether he gets a re-entry remains unconfirmed.
k: Bigg Boss 20 Nakul Dhull Gullu Kushal Tanwar Mahhi Vij Qazi Touqeer
x:
Bigg Boss 20 has resolved days of speculation around wildcard contestant Nakul Dhull's fate: multiple outlets that have now covered the broadcast describe an on screen confrontation in which Bigg Boss reprimanded Dhull and ordered him out of the house over his physical altercation with fellow contestant Gullu  Kushal Tanwar . The incident had initially circulated only through unconfirmed social media claims; the newer reports say the eviction itself played out on camera.

   What happened on screen

According to  Leisurebyte's episode recap  https://leisurebyte.com/bigg boss 20 episode 38/ , the trouble began during a nomination task when Qazi Touqeer told housemates he had bitten and spat in ScoutOP's ear as a prank. Nakul, who overheard the exchange, confronted Qazi on ScoutOP's behalf; when Qazi asked Gullu to explain the joke instead, Nakul objected, and the argument between the two men turned physical. Housemates stepped in to separate them, and Mahhi Vij hit Nakul on the back during the scuffle, the report says.

 NewsBytes reported on October 15  https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/entertainment/nakul dhull s shocking eviction from bigg boss 20/story  that Bigg Boss called the house together, reminded contestants that physical violence is a serious rule violation, and asked Dhull to leave as punishment. A separate  Outlook India report on his reaction  https://www.outlookindia.com/art entertainment/television/bigg boss 20 nakul dhull reacts after eviction following fight with gullu  adds that several housemates, including Mahhi, Kanika Mann, Gullu and Aasif Khan, applauded as he was asked to go, and that Nakul raised his middle finger at them before leaving.  Daily Jagran  https://www.thedailyjagran.com/entertainment/news/is nakul dhull evicted from bigg boss 20 after slapping gullu know about his profile controversial statements on women and more 10332382  similarly reports that Bigg Boss scolded Nakul in the living room before announcing his elimination, though it still describes the altercation itself as alleged.

{{youtube: IgaF53Xzww}}

   Nakul's reaction, and what's still unclear

Outlook reports that shortly after leaving, Dhull posted an Instagram Story reading "apne 2 din      unke 100 din"  "my 2 days are worth more than their 100 days" , without naming anyone directly. He has not given a longer, on record statement about the incident since.

What remains unresolved is whether Dhull will get a second chance. Social media posts have speculated about a possible re entry within days, a theory  Deccan Chronicle reported  https://www.deccanchronicle.com/entertainment/television/nakul re entry into bigg boss 20 1995676  but said the makers have not confirmed. Gullu's side had earlier called the fight a "planned attack" on Instagram and pushed for Dhull's removal; there has been no on record response to that claim from Dhull.

{{youtube:9h Q3hntwKg}}

   Background

Dhull entered Bigg Boss 20 as a wildcard contestant during a Weekend Ka Vaar episode hosted by Salman Khan, according to  Navbharat Live  https://navbharatlive.com/entertainment/bigg boss 20 nakul dhull evicted on first day fight with gullu aan25 , which reported that he was removed the same day the fight aired — one of the shortest stints of the season. Colors TV and JioHotstar, which air and stream the show respectively, had not issued a separate statement on the eviction as of the latest reports.

! img:0 

TeaPost had earlier reported that the fight's fallout, including the eviction and re entry claims, was unconfirmed; this update reflects the broadcast outcome as now described by outlets that covered the episode. We will update this story again if Colors, JioHotstar or Dhull issue a direct, on record statement.

t: Rise and Fall 2: Shehzad Poonawalla's Ultimate Ruler Reign Ends as Sara Gurpal Clashes With Gautam Gulati
d: Shehzad Poonawalla's run as Ultimate Ruler on Rise and Fall 2 came to an end this week, and the same stretch of episodes saw Sara Gurpal and Gautam Gulati clash over a dining-table outburst that Gurpal said stirred memories of an abusive relationship.
k: Rise and Fall 2 Shehzad Poonawalla Sara Gurpal Gautam Gulati
x:
The power equation on Amazon Prime Video and MX Player's  Rise and Fall 2  has shifted again, with political commentator Shehzad Poonawalla's stint as the house's "Ultimate Ruler" coming to a close in the latest run of episodes. The same stretch also produced one of the season's sharper personal confrontations, between Punjabi singer actor Sara Gurpal and former  Bigg Boss  winner Gautam Gulati.

   What happened

 Rise and Fall 2 , hosted by Virender Sehwag, runs on a hierarchy in which contestants are split between a privileged "Penthouse" and a harsher "Basement," with weekly power contests deciding who rules over whom. According to NewsBytes, Poonawalla's run as Ultimate Ruler ended during this phase of the season, a shift the outlet reported as reshuffling alliances and the house's overall power balance.

The end of his reign followed a run in which Poonawalla had used the Ultimate Ruler's authority aggressively. Navbharat Live reported that, while still holding the title, he sent Gulati and fellow contestant Raj Grover down to the Basement while protecting Swara Bhasker and Irina Rudakova in the Penthouse — a decision Gulati reportedly responded to by calling Poonawalla a "traitor." Free Press Journal separately reported that the race for the Ultimate Ruler title had narrowed to a final two, Poonawalla and Gulati, after Irina Rudakova was voted out of contention in an earlier round.

   The confrontation

In a related episode, Navbharat Live reported that Gulati warned Gurpal and Grover against attempting what he called a "takhta palat," or overthrow, inside the house. The exchange escalated when Gulati, reacting angrily, stomped his foot on the dining table; Gurpal responded by climbing onto the table herself and knocking items off it, according to the outlet.

NewsBytes reported that Gurpal went further in calling out Gulati, telling him she used to respect him but that his conduct in the moment reminded her of an abusive relationship from her past. The outlet described real emotion surfacing in the house as a result, with the confrontation unfolding against an already tense backdrop from a separate rivalry between contestants Kaira Anu and Rishabh Jaiswal. Gulati has not issued any public response to Gurpal's remarks.

   Background

The season, which premiered on September 26, has repeatedly turned the Ultimate Ruler contest into the show's flashpoint. In an early episode, LeisureByte reported that evicted contestant Siwet Tomar physically grabbed Poonawalla by the collar after Poonawalla named him the "weakest decision maker" in that week's Ultimate Ruler race — a title fight that also saw Karan Patel and Swara Bhasker briefly walk out in protest before Tomar was voted off the show. The makers subsequently reminded contestants on air that physical violence would not be tolerated.

   What's next

With Poonawalla no longer Ultimate Ruler, the show has yet to confirm who holds the title now or whether Gulati's position in the house will change as a result. Neither Poonawalla nor Gulati has commented publicly outside the show on either incident.

t: Bigg Boss 20: Nakul Dhull and Gullu's Physical Clash Leaves Wildcard's Fate Unclear
d: A scuffle in the house, a 'major' rule violation and a flood of unconfirmed exit rumours: what has actually been reported about the Nakul Dhullâ€“Gullu fight.
k: Bigg Boss 20 Nakul Dhull Gullu Kushal Tanwar Qazi Touqeer
x:
A physical fight between wildcard entrant Nakul Dhull and fellow contestant Gullu  Kushal Tanwar  has put  Bigg Boss 20  at the centre of the internet's attention this week. Bigg Boss reportedly called the clash a serious rule violation, and social media is full of claims that Nakul has been evicted. Neither he nor the show's makers have officially confirmed an exit, so much of what is circulating is still unverified.

   What happened in the house

According to  OdishaBytes  https://odishabytes.com/bigg boss 20 did nakul dhull get evicted after clash with gullu/amp/ , the trouble began after a nomination task, when Nakul confronted Qazi Touqeer over remarks he allegedly made about ScoutOP behind his back. Qazi reportedly said the comment was made in jest and asked Gullu to step in. The argument then turned physical.

The reports describe the fight as alleged. Nakul allegedly charged at and pushed Gullu, who retaliated, and Nakul tore Gullu's sweater before other housemates managed to separate them. Outlook also describes the fight as "alleged" throughout, and accounts differ on some details, including who made the first move.

{{youtube:yimodr9kudY}}

   Bigg Boss and the housemates react

The episode reportedly ended on a cliffhanger. Bigg Boss summoned the contestants, reminded them that physical violence is a serious violation of the show's rules, and described the altercation as a "major" breach, per OdishaBytes. Mahhi Vij reportedly reprimanded Nakul and demanded his eviction, while several female contestants condemned the incident and raised safety concerns.

! img:0 

The show is hosted by Salman Khan, whose Weekend Ka Vaar episodes are where conduct is traditionally addressed.

   The eviction claim: what is and is not confirmed

The claim that Nakul was evicted traces mainly to the X account BB Tak,  Outlook reports  https://www.outlookindia.com/art entertainment/television/bigg boss 20 nakul dhull reportedly evicted from bigg after fight with gullu , and to gossip pages. As of the latest coverage found, neither Nakul nor the makers of  Bigg Boss 20  have confirmed it. Outlook separately reports that Nakul posted a cryptic Instagram story that did not name anyone.

Further claims are circulating and remain unverified:

  A viral post says Nakul is in a "secret room" rather than gone, a theory that  Boldsky  https://www.boldsky.com/insync/bigg boss 20 is nakul dhull in the secret room after physical clash with gullu 173335.html  says fans are discussing.
  Social media posts suggest he could make a re entry within a day or two, as noted in a  Deccan Chronicle  https://www.deccanchronicle.com/entertainment/television/nakul re entry into bigg boss 20 1995676  report. The makers have not confirmed this.
  A BB Tak post citing unnamed sources alleges that Nakul planned the fight to leave the show. This is unsubstantiated.

   Gullu's team calls it a 'planned attack'

Gullu's team said on Instagram that the fight was a "planned attack", according to OdishaBytes. They asked how news of a physical altercation was leaked on Saturday when, they say, the fight happened on Sunday, and called for Nakul's eviction. The OdishaBytes report did not include any statement from Nakul, Qazi Touqeer or the production team in response.

{{youtube:enI0wN9Ab0I}}

   What to watch next

The answer to the central question, whether Nakul stays or goes, will come from the show itself, most likely in the next episodes or the upcoming weekend episode. Until then, viewers should treat eviction and re entry claims from fan pages and unnamed sources with caution. We will update this story if the makers or the contestants make an official statement.
